title: Initialize bandit strategies from prior evidence
description: You distinguish computed posterior rewards from the values passed into each strategy.

steps.description: You add one to past successes and failures to form alpha_prior and beta_prior. Their ratio gives posterior mean success probabilities, which become expected net rewards.

steps.question: Does epsilon-greedy receive the computed init_mean_reward array?
steps.answer: Its constructor receives init_mean=0.0. The computed array is not passed to that constructor in this block.

steps.description: You create epsilon-greedy with exploration rate 0.1 and a UCB1 object. ThompsonSampling receives alpha_prior and beta_prior explicitly.
You print posterior mean expected rewards [3.6364,4.6923,18.3333,7.6364,5.5455]. These printed estimates come from prior evidence and the reward and cost arrays.
